items.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong- Jeremy Schon & Greg Ormont interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 8, 2024
items.q: Jeremy and Greg were interviewed via Zoom on March 8, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

ctx.x: Jeremy and Greg were interviewed via Zoom on March 8, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased, at 10 AM in the morning, to have Greg Ormont and Jeremy Schon here from the band Pigeons Playing Ping Pong. Welcome, gentlemen.
